description: This Java source file contains JUnit test cases for testing the EncounterDAO implementation in the OpenMRS project. It specifically tests retrieving encounter data from the database, including getting saved encounter datetimes and searching encounters by different criteria.

classes.name: EncounterDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for EncounterDAO, testing database interactions for Encounter entity in OpenMRS.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes test data and retrieves the EncounterDAO bean from the application context before each test.

methods.name: getSavedEncounterDatetime_shouldGetSavedEncounterDatetimeFromDatabase
methods.description: Tests that the DAO correctly retrieves the original saved encounter datetime from the database.

methods.name: getEncounters_shouldWork_WithNameQuery
methods.description: Tests retrieving encounters based on a name query string.

methods.name: getEncounters_shouldWork_WithIdentifierQuery
methods.description: Tests retrieving encounters based on numeric and string identifier queries.

methods.name: initializeExpectedEncounters
methods.description: Helper method to prepare expected encounter objects for assertions.

methods.name: getEncounters_shouldNotWork_WithPartialIdentifier
methods.description: Tests that a partial identifier query returns no encounters.
